name: Tirias
source:
Tirias fully lives up to the rumors of being the shady own of the Dark Decent, an alchemy shop located in the outer part of Crimson City. Born and raised in Terestran, many people believe him to be a former mage killer...

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
